item.nusmp.spirit_king_sceptre: Sceptre of the Celestial Spirit King
message.nusmp.celestial.already_bound: You already hold a contract with %s.
message.nusmp.celestial.closing: The Spirit World is closing: %s s.
message.nusmp.celestial.complete: All twelve Gold Zodiac keys are yours. A thirteenth key, pale as starlight, has appeared: the key of the Celestial Gate.
message.nusmp.celestial.enter: The Gate closes behind you. The Celestial Spirit King waits in the middle of the stars.
message.nusmp.celestial.found: A key answers your hand: %s. (%s of 12 gold keys)
message.nusmp.celestial.full: Every cell of the Spirit World is in use. Wait a little.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate: The Celestial Gate opens. The twelve keys sing. Choose:
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.bound: Every one of the twelve keys needs a sealed contract.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.closed: The Gate is closed. Use the gate key to open it.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.cooldown: The King will not see you again for %s minutes.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.keys: The Gate needs all twelve Gold Zodiac keys on you (%s of 12).
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.nokey: You need the key of the Gate.
message.nusmp.celestial.gate.open: The Gate is already open: choose.
message.nusmp.celestial.king.death: "You kept faith with every one of them. Go, keeper of the stars."
message.nusmp.celestial.king.judgement: The King raises his sceptre: stand in the golden circle!
message.nusmp.celestial.king.resist: The King shrugs it off. (Legendary Resistance, %s left)
message.nusmp.celestial.known: You already know Celestial Spirit Magic.
message.nusmp.celestial.learned: The stars answer: Celestial Spirit Magic is yours.
message.nusmp.celestial.no_magicules: Not enough magicules for the contract.
message.nusmp.celestial.not_yours: This key keeps a contract with someone else.
message.nusmp.celestial.noworld: The Spirit World is closed: its dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.celestial.recognition.no: He does not know you well enough: all twelve spirits need a bond of at least 2 and the skill half mastered (or you were already recognised).
message.nusmp.celestial.released: The contract with %s is broken. The key is free.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.again: The King nods. He has already given you all he has.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.helper: The King thanks you and mends you. His gifts are for the keeper of all twelve keys.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.mode: New modes: the Spirit King's Blessing and the Summon of the Spirit King.
message.nusmp.celestial.reward.mode2: New mode: the Spirit King's Blessing.
nusmp.skill.celestial_spirit_magic.descr: Unique. Call the spirits of the stars with their golden and silver keys, wear their power as Star Dress forms, and open the Celestial Gate when all twelve Gold Zodiac keys are yours.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.dress_closed: The %s is not open to you yet.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.king_closed: The Spirit King has not given you this.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.no_key: You do not carry the %s key.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.not_bound: No contract with %s yet: hold the key's use button to seal one.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.not_yours: That key keeps a contract with someone else.
nusmp.skill.msg.celestial.too_many: Your mastery lets you keep fewer spirits at once.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.book: Teaches the Unique skill Celestial Spirit Magic.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.book2: Call the spirits of the zodiac with their keys; Star Dress forms open with mastery.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.gate_key: The key of the Celestial Gate.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.gate_key2: Carry all twelve Gold Zodiac keys, each with its contract, and use it to open the Gate.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.sceptre: Starlight Mend: heals you and your allies within 8 blocks (30 s cooldown).
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.sceptre2: Left to the one who bested the Celestial Spirit King.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.slot: Carry it, or wear it in the Celestial Key slot, to call the spirit with Celestial Spirit Magic.
tooltip.nusmp.celestial.unbound: No contract. Hold use to seal one (sneak + use breaks it).
